problem: Find a vector equation of the straight line passing through $P(3,-2,5)$ and parallel to $v=⟨4,1,6⟩.$
worked_solution:
The vector equation of the straight line passing through $P$ and parallel to $v$ is given by

$$
r=p+tv,
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty )$ and $p$ is the position vector of $P.$

In our case, the position vector of the point $P$ is $p=⟨3,-2,5⟩.$

Using the formula for the vector equation of a line, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}r=⟨3,-2,5⟩+t⟨4,1,6⟩,\,t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$
